5837.titolo: fix(ErdosProblems/1000): exclude denominators dividing an earlier term
5837.corpo: `Erdos1000.phiSeq` counted the `1 ≤ m ≤ n_k` whose reduced denominator `n_k/(m,n_k)` is *not equal to* any earlier term `n_j`. The primary source, Erdős [Er64b] (Compositio Math. 16, p. 59), defines `φ(n_1,…,n_{k−1}; n_k)` as the number of `1 ≤ a ≤ n_k` with `a/n_k ≠ b/n_j` for every `j < k` and every integer `b`. Since `a/n_k = b/n_j` is solvable in `b` exactly when the reduced denominator of `a/n_k` *divides* `n_j`, the correct condition is `n_k/(m,n_k) ∤ n_j`.
